speaker: client
text:
Hi Naveed,

Our small nonprofit organization (<http://silverpine-studio.example|silverpine-studio.example>) is launching a YouTube channel, and we need a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally, it would be ready by the end of next week (thursday or friday). If you can help, I can send the video, a google doc containing thumbnail ideas and guidance, and one thumbnail I tried making myself. We would prefer the thumbnail not to contain AI-created assets, although minor AI-assisted edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably okay. Would you be able to help?

speaker: freelancer
text:
Hi caleb,

I believe I can help with this. When you're available, let's discuss it in more detail. Please also share information about the channel and its content, along with the previous thumbnail you made yourself.

speaker: client
text:
I've put the thumbnail ideas and guidance in this google doc:
<https://docs.google.example/document/d/silverpine-planning-brief-2048/edit?usp=sharing>

You can view the current cut of the video here:
<https://drive.google.example/file/d/silverpine-demo-reel-7315/view?usp=sharing>

I've also attached the thumbnail I made, though I think it's only okay.

speaker: freelancer
text: The existing design can definitely be improved. Would delivery of the finished thumbnail within 72-96hrs work for you?

speaker: freelancer
text: To help guide the design, could you send any competitors or examples that appeal to you? If there are brand guidelines I should follow, please share those too.

speaker: freelancer
text: Please send over the title you currently have in mind for the video. I can provide additional title variations alongside yours so that we can run an A/B Test as well.

speaker: freelancer
text:
I have one question about the payment setup. Although I don't mind working hourly, watching the clock while I work can sometimes make it difficult to concentrate. If you're comfortable with the change, could we move to milestone-based fixed pricing instead?

Please share your thoughts so we can get started as soon as possible.

speaker: client
text: The offer has been modified to reflect that change!

speaker: client
text: I've included all of my preferences and reference ideas in the google doc. Would that document be enough for you?

speaker: freelancer
text: caleb, I'll quickly review the document now.

speaker: freelancer
text: It looks like I now have the video, ideas, examples, and your thoughts. One final question remains: should I extract your image from the video, or do you have separate headshot photos available?

speaker: client
text:
Regarding your A/B Test suggestion, we are planning to use three titles for A/B testing:

Inside the automated newsroom linked to OpenAI’s super PAC.
Who bankrolls the bot reporters? Following OpenAI’s super PAC trail.
The hidden network behind an OpenAI-backed automated news site.

speaker: client
text: If that works for you, I'd prefer to take my image from the video itself.

speaker: freelancer
text: That approach is possible, but I generally prefer separately taken headshots because they provide better image quality and give us more poses to work with. If that isn't possible, I can extract images from the video instead, and we can change the result if you don't like it.

speaker: client
text: Thank you, that sounds great! For future videos, we could potentially take more headshot-style photos.

speaker: client
text: For the current thumbnail, though, frame grabs from the current recording should work well.

speaker: freelancer
text: For transparency, here is the section of Ai I may use. I do not use Ai for asset creation, though I might generate some elements or alter parts of photos with Generative Ai or other Ai's. Whatever is changed would be kept natural so it does not look made by Ai.

speaker: client
text: I'd prefer that you not use either of those methods—please don't generate new elements or alter parts of the photographs that way.
